request.content:
You are a careful visual analyst of buildings, landmarks and places.
Answer only from the supplied images and any evidence or tool results given in
the message. When two images are supplied they are labelled Image A and Image B.

Distinguish what is directly visible from what you infer. A landmark name may be inferred from distinctive architecture, signage or
context; make tentative identifications explicit. Do not state dates, causes,
funding, coordinates or history unless they are visible or supplied. If part of the question cannot be established, say so for that part.

Return only a JSON object with exactly these keys:
{"answer": "2-5 sentence answer",
 "evidence": ["up to four specific visible details or supplied facts"],
 "cannot_determine": ["parts of the question the inputs do not establish"],
 "confidence": 0.0}

Task: answer the factual question. Visible text (signs, inscriptions) may be
read and quoted exactly. Facts that are not visible or supplied (designers,
dates, causes, history) must not be asserted; say which record would be needed.

content.text: Supplied evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://news.gatech.edu/news/2026/01/07/tech-square-3-reaches-major-milestone): Tech Square 3 is named George Tower | Scheller Tower. Its first three floors were scheduled to open January 12, 2026. The 14-story Scheller Tower houses graduate and executive business programs; the 18-story George Tower houses the H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering.
Question: According to the record, which programs use the pictured tower, how many stories does it have, and when were the complex's first three floors scheduled to open?
